purpose: Generate the compact execution view (compact-v1) from the frozen method originals verbatim. Sections are only ever dropped whole or de-duplicated by exact text; no wording is rewritten, merged or summarized. Frozen originals stay readable at their context paths.
paragraph_split: blank-line separated blocks inside a section body, code fences kept atomic

actions.exclude: section omitted from the execution view (recorded with reason)
actions.keep_drop_code_blocks: prose kept verbatim, fenced code blocks (verbose formal trace format examples) dropped; the running short-decision contract replaces them
actions.keep_paragraphs_matching: only body blocks containing one of `markers` are kept verbatim; used for sections that mix non-executing shell steps with frozen research rules

dedup: exact duplicate body blocks (whitespace-normalized) are dropped after their first occurrence and recorded
